measures.what: distance from the center of the output shaft to the nearest end of the case (end face, not the tab)
measures.reply: servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo spline: 5.84 mm (the output shaft, across its splines, where an arm would grip it; there's a smaller reading of 5.60 at the very top, and I'm not sure which feature that was)

measures.item: MG996R servo with aluminium single arm horn fitted
measures.what: height from the top face of the case to the top face of the horn's hub, with the horn pushed fully onto the spline
measures.reply: servo body height: 40.4 mm (the case, top to bottom); servo spline: 5.84 mm (the output shaft, across its splines, where an arm would grip it; there's a smaller reading of 5.60 at the very top, and I'm not sure which feature that was); servo horns: four plastic horns came with it (a double arm, a six-arm star, a round disc and a cross), and I bought a 25-tooth aluminium single arm (the aluminium arm's hub is 14.66 across and 5.95 thick, the arm 3.86 thick, 34.62 from the hub's far edge to the tip, with 2.55 holes; I didn't measure where the holes are, or the plastic horns)

measures.what: width of the flat arm where it meets the hub, and width at the tip
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: center-to-center spacing between the two holes on one tab, and how far each tab sticks out beyond the case end
measures.reply: servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab); servo rib width: 1.51 mm (a rib on each tab's top face (the shaft side), between the tab's two holes; it stops the tabs sitting flush); servo rib height: 1.8 mm (how far the rib stands up from the tab's top face); servo rib position: 8.31 mm (from the side of the holes to the middle of the rib)

measures.what: outer diameter (calipers square across the flat outer ring, not at the jaw tips) and width
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

limitations.wanted: M2.5 screws to bolt the arm to the aluminium horn's 2.55 mm holes
limitations.blocked_by: not in the hardware list (smallest is M3, which won't pass 2.55 mm holes)
limitations.why: A screwed horn joint would have no backlash and no risk of lifting off. Instead the arm grips the horn with a shaped pocket, and the bearing cap stops it lifting.
